question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Accredit
solution:
The correct answer is **"Certify"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here we will see the meaning of the given words:

__
 
• **Accredit - ** give credit to (someone) for something

 
 
• ***​Eg.*** He was *accredited* with being one of the world's fastest sprinters
 
 
 
• **​Certify -** attest or confirm in a formal statement. 
 
 
• ***​Eg. ***The profits for the year had been *certified* by the auditors​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Here we will see the meaning of other given synonyms:

 
• **Confide -** tell someone about a secret or private matter while trusting them not to repeat it to others

 
 
• ***​Eg.*** He *confided* his fears to his mother.
 
 
 
• **Rely -** depend on with full trust or confidence. 
 
 
• ***​Eg. ***I know I can *rely* on your discretion
 
 
 
• **​Trust -** firm belief in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone or something 
 
 
• ​***Eg. ***Relations have to be built on *trust*.
